description: This file defines external API prototypes for a Circular Buffer object in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It includes function declarations for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the circular buffer, serving as an interface for external modules to interact with the buffer implementations.

methods.name: AnscCreateCircularBuffer
methods.description: Creates a circular buffer object with specified container, owner, and reserve context handles.

methods.name: AnscCboCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Circular Buffer object with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscCboRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the Circular Buffer object.

methods.name: AnscCboEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects within the Circular Buffer context.

methods.name: AnscCboInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Circular Buffer object, setting up necessary internal state.
